title: BS-P1-025 T006 R2: exact F00-001/038 fixture maintenance authority and guard-preserving lint refactor

why5.question: Why does T006 R2 PR #374 fail CI and Governance Gate despite reported 76 local browser E2E passes?
why5.answer: R2 modified two previously owned tests to reflect the locked BS-P1-025 PoP proof and read-only delivery protocol; active T006 lacked the narrow explicit test maintenance authorization. CI rejected both mapped legacy test body changes.

why5.question: Why exactly these two maintenance authorizations rather than relaxed validation or test deletion?
why5.answer: The gate matches an authorization by original TEST ID and exact test path under mode BASELINE_FIXTURE_REBIND from direct superseded BS-P1-024 to locked BS-P1-025. Preserve legacy blank-prompt, capsule editable, one logical CREATE and no unauthorized admission guarantees. Do not change closed Task definitions.

why5.question: Why must the protected harness lint refactor be in this separately governed patch?
why5.answer: The merged main checkT006T008Order function exceeds ESLint complexity threshold 15; splitting identical checks into helpers preserves test guard predicates and error ordering. Unchanged synthetic T006/T008 order cases must be rerun before approval.

why5.question: Why adjust the execution-time scope gate instead of bypassing it?
why5.answer: T006 ACTIVE normally rejects delivery/sprints and harness governance-only path changes. An exact four-path, exact old-main-SHA and Task-field-only exception supports this one narrowly authorized correction including its constitutional docket; other governance or Product edits remain forbidden.

why5.question: What does this PR NOT approve or complete?
why5.answer: It cannot validate absent TEST-F00-037, missing live S05 session owner, mobile Inspection CTA mismatch, live-model/real-PG browser path, product PR merge, T008 or T006 closure. No Task status, build baseline or historical CLOSED Task changes. Human exact-byte approval and a separate merge decision are still required.
